tower-two.text: Tower Two to Birch Seven. Bridge instructions. Follow the lights into the lower cut.

porch-tape.text: I shut the inner gate. Cal is still answering from the far bank, so I left the crossing open. Follow the porch light. Mind the board just inside the gate. It split this morning.

ranger-briefing.text: I pulled one man out. Then the other Cal called my name from the far bank. I left him there. We can go back, but first hear the family out.

segments.text: Close it before another one walks into our kitchen.
The voice across the water called me Cricket. Only Uncle Cal calls me that.

arch-sealed.text: Foxglove to all stations. The crossing is sealed. All further crossings are cancelled.

arch-open.text: Foxglove to both banks. The crossing remains open. Search crews, check in at the diner.
